title: The Flooded Boathouse
method: Built-in image generation; one generation per phase, with targeted corrections to phases 01 and 02.
status: Illustrative Discord-native storyboard; not a live session or an implementation.
basePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE image for one phase of an eight-phase illustrated short Discord game, “The Flooded Boathouse”.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE only. Match its restrained dark Discord appearance and legible message/button typography, not its old story text.
This is an illustrative sample game, not a live-server screenshot. All controls must be feasible through native Discord bot messages, standard Markdown Text Displays, Action Rows of at most FIVE buttons, and button-triggered modal text forms. Ephemeral messages show “Only you can see this • Dismiss message” below the message, never a permanent private panel. No custom persistent dashboard, no custom app chrome, no dice widgets, no HP bars or map overlays, no fixed pinned-menu header. Native button colors only: flat blurple for a main action, gray secondary, green confirmation, gray-disabled for completed actions. Content-sized compact buttons, no full-width grids.
Output a wide landscape two-state storyboard, approximately 16:10, with sharp LARGE readable text and consistent spacing. Two app crops are separate moments, NOT invented side-by-side panes within Discord. Keep the tiny channel sidebar narrow and reserve most of each crop for message text. Flat, front-on, no perspective. White caption band OUTSIDE the app crops has the numbered phase title, with short labels above each moment. Both app crops have the same ordinary server name “Raphael’s Council”, channel “# greyharbor”, simple # how-to-play channel, and standard “Message #greyharbor” composer. No member list necessary.
Raphael appears as a normal app account, circular letter-R avatar, username “Raphael”, APP badge. Player text submitted through a modal is restated in Raphael’s ordinary message as “Maren says” or “Rowan intends”; do not falsely show the bot posting as a human user. Story takes place on Day 6. Two heroes only: Maren, a ranger and session host; Rowan, a cleric. Ferry keeper Elin is an NPC. These are sample characters.
Keep exact arithmetic, turn owner, time, and control labels specified below. Small sample indicator “Illustrative session” may appear in the OUTSIDE caption only. Render the named text verbatim with no extra lore. Do not put draggable dice, selectable cards, embedded input fields or web widgets into channel messages. When showing a modal it must be a separate state: centered native dialog over a dimmed channel, with a real text input and standard Cancel/Submit footer. If no modal is specified, do not invent one.
PHASE CONTENT:

Do not invent extra story paragraphs, field character counters, or game statistics. Use only the supplied text; optional timestamps can be omitted. All requested text and arithmetic must remain exact.

PRIVACY ACCURACY: Only messages explicitly specified as PRIVATE or ephemeral get an 'Only you can see this' footer. A SHARED result or decision must NEVER get that footer. Do not copy privacy labels to all messages.

phases.title: 01 · JOIN THE COMPANY
phases.prompt:
Outside phase title “01 · JOIN THE COMPANY”. Left moment caption “Join with ordinary words”; right “Approve heroes and gather”.
LEFT: native modal triggered by Join the company. App header Raphael, close X, title “Join the Lantern Compact”. Two labeled text fields: “What is your hero called?” containing “Maren”; “Describe your hero” paragraph containing “A ranger who keeps her promises. I carry a lantern and always go back for others.” Standard Cancel and Submit buttons. Dimmed backdrop includes a normal bot entry message with Join the company button.
RIGHT: shared lobby message headed “Gather the company”. Text “Day 6 · 17:00 · The Last Hearth”. Roster plain text “Maren — Ranger — Hero approved — Ready” and “Rowan — Cleric — Hero approved — Ready”. Text “2 of 2 ready. The host can begin.” Action row “I’m ready” green, “Sit this session out” gray, “My hero” gray. Second row “Begin session” blurple and “Back to deck” gray. Only the host viewing this screen can press Begin session. Small separate earlier private message to Maren above the lobby: “Your hero draft is approved.” Native ephemeral footer. Do not display somebody else’s private character notes.

phases.title: 02 · BRIEFING AND AGREEMENT
phases.prompt:
Outside phase title “02 · BRIEFING AND AGREEMENT”. Left moment “Read the request”; right “Both players agree”.
LEFT: native private briefing from Raphael headed “The Flooded Boathouse”, body “Day 6 · 17:00” then “Lysa asks you to bring ferry keeper Elin home before high tide.” then “Deadline: 18:00. Travel: 10 minutes each way.” then “An old magical ward seals the boathouse.” Button row “Propose this mission” blurple, “Ask about the mission” gray. Second row “Other missions”, “My hero”, “Back to deck”. Ephemeral footer.
RIGHT: shared company decision message heading “Company decision”. Body “Go together and bring Elin home.” then “Known travel: 20 minutes total. No items committed.” List “Maren — Supports” and “Rowan — Supports”. Text “2 of 2 support this plan.” Native button row “Support plan”, “Object”, “Discuss or suggest changes” all gray. Second row “Withdraw my response” gray, “Confirm agreed plan” green enabled, “Pause play” gray. Under it, a separate short later Raphael narration: “Plan confirmed. Day 6 · 17:10. You reach the boathouse.” In the earlier decision ABOVE this later narration, the confirm and vote buttons are now DISABLED to show it has committed. Keep the green-confirm intention understandable with muted disabled rendering. Do not imply one player casts both votes.

phases.title: 03 · TURN 1 — MAREN INVESTIGATES
phases.prompt:
Outside phase title “03 · TURN 1 — MAREN INVESTIGATES”. Left moment “Look closer”; right “Confirm, roll, discover”.
LEFT: a native modal titled “Look closer” from Raphael. Label “What do you examine?” paragraph field contains “I study the marks on the boathouse door to understand what is holding it shut.” Native Cancel/Submit. The dimmed channel behind it says “Spotlight: Maren · Day 6 · 17:10”. This is narrative spotlight order, not combat initiative.
RIGHT: ordinary Raphael messages. First actor-private check record “Maren’s Investigation” with text “Check: 1d20 + 3 · Target: 12”. “Your action was confirmed.” A gray DISABLED “Roll dice” button (it has already resolved), plus native ephemeral footer. Then shared result message heading “The ferry ward”. Arithmetic exact “d20: 9 + modifier: 3 = 12” and “Target: 12 · Success”. Outcome “Three lantern marks repeat across the ward. Their pattern can steady its light.” Then “Day 6 · 17:15 · Next spotlight: Rowan”. Native buttons “Continue scene”, “What changed?”, “Pause play”. No reroll or extra dice. Show only the information discovered, not the ward’s complete solution.

phases.title: 04 · TURN 2 — ROWAN SEEKS GUIDANCE
phases.prompt:
Outside phase title “04 · TURN 2 — ROWAN SEEKS GUIDANCE”. Left moment “A private hint”; right “Share, speak, get an answer”.
LEFT shows Rowan’s private view, not Maren’s. Raphael ephemeral response heading “Raphael’s counsel”. Exact hint “Before you ask the door to open, ask who is listening.” Native buttons “Share with the party”, “Ask a follow-up”, “Back to deck”. Below it a second smaller ephemeral share-confirmation message heading “Share this counsel?” repeats the exact same hint. Buttons “Share this hint” green, “Keep it private” gray. Native ephemeral footers. Small plain text “Reading counsel does not advance time.” No disclosure of Rowan’s raw question in public.
RIGHT: same channel after Rowan confirmed sharing and used Speak. Ordinary public Raphael message heading “Counsel shared by Rowan”, text exact “Before you ask the door to open, ask who is listening.” Next public Raphael narration “Rowan says: ‘Elin, are you inside?’” then “Elin answers: ‘Here! The ward will not release me.’” then “No roll needed. Elin can hear you.” then “Day 6 · 17:20 · Next spotlight: Maren”. Native buttons “Do something else”, “Speak”, “Look closer”, “Help an ally”, “Ask Raphael” on one row; “My hero”, “Journal”, “Pause play” on second. Hint sharing is deliberate, never automatic.

phases.title: 05 · TURN 3 — MAREN HELPS ROWAN
phases.prompt:
Outside phase title “05 · TURN 3 — MAREN HELPS ROWAN”. Left moment “Describe the help”; right “Review and commit the help”.
LEFT native modal “Help an ally” from Raphael. Label “Who do you help, and how?” typed paragraph “I hold my lantern beside Rowan’s and follow the ward pattern I recognized, helping him steady its light.” Cancel/Submit standard footer. Dim background mentions “Spotlight: Maren · Day 6 · 17:20”.
RIGHT messages in Maren’s view: private action review heading “Help Rowan with the ferry ward”. Text “Your discovered pattern makes this help effective.” then “Benefit: advantage on Rowan’s next Arcana check.” then “Cost: 5 minutes. No item consumed.” Three buttons “Confirm action”, “Change my approach”, “Cancel action”, all DISABLED in this later state because Maren already confirmed. Native ephemeral footer. Below, a shared bot result heading “The lights hold steady”. Text “Maren’s help is ready for Rowan’s next check.” then “Day 6 · 17:25 · Next spotlight: Rowan”. Buttons “Continue scene”, “What changed?”, “Pause play”. Make it clear help is committed once and does not roll for Rowan or control his hero.

phases.title: 06 · TURN 4 — ROWAN ROLLS
phases.prompt:
Outside phase title “06 · TURN 4 — ROWAN ROLLS”. Left moment “The requested check”; right “Saved result and rescue”.
LEFT private Raphael check message headed “Release the ferry ward”. Text “Rowan intends: ‘I calm the ward and open a way for Elin.’” then “Arcana · Advantage from Maren’s help” then “Roll 2d20, keep the higher, then add +2.” then “Target: 13. Failure costs 5 minutes.” then “No dice have been rolled yet.” Native row “Roll dice” blurple, “Change my approach” gray, “Cancel action” gray. Ephemeral footer. Small game time “Day 6 · 17:25”.
RIGHT shared result message headed “Rowan’s Arcana”. Arithmetic EXACT in separate readable lines: “d20 rolls: 6 and 16” then “Keep: 16” then “Modifier: +2” then bold “Total: 18” then “Target: 13 · Success”. Narration “The ward opens. Elin steps safely outside.” followed by “Day 6 · 17:30 · Rescue complete”. Small text “Example saved check · GH-0042”. Native buttons “Continue scene” and “What changed?”. Below, private response “This check is complete.” with a gray DISABLED “Roll dice” button and ephemeral footer. Show numbers only as ordinary message text, NEVER a dice roller widget or native 3D dice animation. No active reroll button.

phases.title: 07 · DEBRIEF — THE WORLD REMEMBERS
phases.prompt:
Outside phase title “07 · DEBRIEF — THE WORLD REMEMBERS”. Left moment “Return and review”; right “Agree to end here”.
LEFT ordinary shared Raphael message heading “Back at the Last Hearth”. Body “Day 6 · 17:40” then “Elin is home before high tide.” then “The rescue took 40 minutes, including the return journey.” then “No items consumed. No injuries.” Subheading “Changes recorded” with short ordinary text lines “Elin trusts the company.” and “Open lead: repair the unstable ferry ward.” Native rows: “Read the record”, “Flag a correction”, “Plan downtime”; then “Next requests”, “Propose session end”, “Pause play”. No invisible stat bars, no invented XP values.
RIGHT shared decision message heading “End the session here?” text “Save at Day 6 · 17:40. Advance no game time.” Plain roster “Maren — Supports”, “Rowan — Supports”, “2 of 2 support”. Native row “Support plan”, “Object”, “Discuss or suggest changes”. Second row “Withdraw my response”, “Confirm agreed plan” enabled GREEN, “Pause play”. Small plain reminder “One response per player.” This moment is BEFORE pressing the final confirm. The world changes on the left are already saved and are not applied twice by viewing the debrief.

phases.title: 08 · SAVE AND RESUME
phases.prompt:
Outside phase title “08 · SAVE AND RESUME”. Left moment “Session saved”; right “Returning days later”.
LEFT ordinary shared Raphael saved-session message heading “The lanterns will be here”. Text “Saved: Day 6 · 17:40 · The Last Hearth”. Then “Elin: safely home.” then “Open lead: repair the ferry ward.” then “Example save receipt: GH-S01”. Then “The world does not advance while you are away.” Native button row “Gather to resume”, “Read the journal”, “My hero”, “Back to deck”. No fake physical save-file dialog.
RIGHT ordinary shared lobby on a later real-world visit. Heading “Gather to resume”. Body “Last saved moment: Day 6 · 17:40”. then “The Last Hearth · Same world, same consequences.” Readiness list “Maren — Not ready” and “Rowan — Not ready”. “0 of 2 ready. No offline game time has passed.” Native row “I’m ready” GREEN, “Sit this session out” gray, “My hero” gray. Second row “Begin session” DISABLED GRAY, “Back to deck” gray. Do not automatically mark anyone ready or advance the calendar. Narrative game day and time must exactly match the left panel. This ends the eight-phase sample game.
